old: Counting both deals, Anthropic estimates net proceeds of $84.6 billion to $93.7 billion, TechCrunch reported.[^3]
new: Counting both deals at the $74 midpoint, Anthropic estimates net proceeds of $84.6 billion, or $93.7 billion with the underwriters' option.[^3][^7]
why: The S-1/A specifies that $84.6 billion and $93.7 billion are both estimated at the $74.00 midpoint, without and with full exercise of the underwriters' 123.75 million-share option, rather than across the $70 to $78 price range.

support.quote: will be approximately $84.6 billion (or approximately $93.7 billion if the underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares of our Class A common stock is exercised in full), based upon the assumed initial public offering price of $74.00 per share
